title: DISABLED test_select_SparseBSC_int32_cuda_bfloat16 (__main__.TestSparseCSRCUDA)
bug_description:
Platforms: rocm

This test is being disabled because it is flaky in the CI - fails with SIGIOT and causes other tests that ran before it to go missing in the xml files e.g. https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/16982935975/job/48147417470. This complicates efforts to assess unit test parity on upstream CI.

Example error snippet:
```
test_sparse_csr.py::TestSparseCSRCUDA::test_select_SparseBSC_int32_cuda_bfloat16 :0:rocdevice.cpp            :2992: 168325437546 us:  Callback: Queue 0x7f5558e00000 aborting with error : HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION: An HSAIL operation resulted in a hardware exception. code: 0x1016
Fatal Python error: Aborted

Thread 0x00007f5522bff6c0 (most recent call first):
  <no Python frame>
...
Got exit code -6 (SIGIOT)
```
